verdict: The local Novera server at localhost:3100 was unstable (a 503, a 404 on /, a goto timeout), which explains three of the four problems; the delivery-date widget stuck on 'Calculating' looks like the one real product bug.

failures.test: Delivery estimate › the delivery date range is calculated from the visitor's date after load
failures.summary: The page loaded with status 200 and no errors, but the delivery date never resolved from its placeholder, so 'Oct 08-12' never appeared.
failures.evidence: Snapshot: term "Delivery Date:" / definition: Calculating delivery date. The same placeholder appears in the flaky test's snapshot, which sets no fake clock.
failures.next_step: Check the client-side delivery-date script on the product page to see why it never replaces 'Calculating delivery date' after load. Then confirm whether 'Within 4 Days' should match the test's 3–5 working-day expectation.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: The local server returned 503, so the product page and #quantity input never rendered.
failures.next_step: Find out why the localhost:3100 server returned 503 (startup or overload) and make the run wait for a healthy server before the tests start, then rerun.

failures.test: Smoke: site health › route responds: home (/)
failures.summary: The home route returned 404, although other tests in the same run got 200 from the same URL, which points to an unstable or not-ready local server rather than a missing route.
failures.evidence: Error: / returned 404 ... Expected: < 400 Received: 404 (other tests' navigation to http://localhost:3100/ got 200)
failures.next_step: Check the local server logs for 404 responses on / during startup, add a readiness check before the smoke spec runs, and rerun.

failures.test: Product info › selecting a colour updates the stock for the selected size
failures.summary: Page navigation in beforeEach timed out once and passed on retry, consistent with the unstable local server in this run.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded ... waiting until "load"; outcome flaky, attempts 2
failures.next_step: No test change needed; fixing the local server's readiness and stability (see the 503 failure) should clear this.
